A LITTLE ABOUT ME

A journey of growth,
with a little sparkle.

Since I was young, I’ve always had one simple goal in life: to help people.

Yet, my journey toward becoming the person I am today hasn’t always been easy. I struggled to embrace my unique lifestyle, perspectives, and way of thinking. Along the way, I encountered voices that belittled me and made me question my worth and the choices I made.

But those experiences didn’t define me. They shaped me.

Today, I stand stronger, kinder, and more confident in who I am. Through learning, teaching, trusting my intuition, and having faith in myself, I’ve found the strength to navigate life’s challenges and embrace my own path.

Now, I hope to share that strength with you.

Whether you’re looking to build confidence, discover the joy of learning a new language, or explore your inner world through tarot, I want to create a space where you feel heard, encouraged, and empowered to become the person you truly want to be.

You’ve always had a little sparkle within you. Let me help you find it.

— Ilaria Sparkles
